response.answer: No data quality problems were found in October 2026's payment data across all 31 days. Every day had zero duplicate attempt IDs, zero null merchant/acquirer/issuer/payment method/status values, zero invalid amounts (null or <= 0), zero failed transactions missing a failure code, zero bad latency values, and zero records ingested before they were created. One thing worth noting (a volume shift rather than a data defect): daily attempts rose from roughly 11,000-13,000 through Oct 17 to about 15,500-18,200 from Oct 18 onward, with a spike of 18,224 on Oct 18. This may reflect real traffic growth, but it's worth confirming. Note that these checks only cover the fields tested and run against the cleaned view (v_attempts_clean), so any issues removed upstream of that view wouldn't show here.
